marketSizing.method: Bottoms-up only: annual qualified visits x paid conversion x average order value.
marketSizing.validationWedge: 20,000 visits x 1.5% x $15 = $4,500 annual revenue [assumption: validation target, not market evidence].
marketSizing.baseNiche: 100,000 visits x 3% x $16 = $48,000 annual revenue [assumption: operator target and .planning validation gate].
marketSizing.upsideNiche: 500,000 visits x 5% x $18 = $450,000 annual revenue [assumption: unvalidated long-tail SEO upside].
marketSizing.notTAM: No top-down TAM claim made; external research unavailable.

LegalZoom [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md; assumption: current feature set not verified]

goToMarket.primary: Validation-first beta in a narrow geography or issue category [assumption: recommended path].
goToMarket.organic: Opt-in public campaign pages and reference content [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md].
gates: Official coverage near 95% federal/state and 60% local [assumption: .planning/PROJECT.md target]

risks: Demand may not exist at $5 to $25 [evidence: code pricing; assumption: no paid evidence].
AI-assisted letters may be treated as civic spam by officials [assumption: operating risk].
Legal/compliance posture is not externally reviewed [evidence: app terms/privacy exist; assumption: no legal opinion found].
Official-contact data may be stale or incomplete [evidence: .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md].
Deliverability can fail even if the product works [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md].
risksAntiPlan.antiPlan: Do not raise venture capital, hire a team, launch broad political-content surfaces, or build coalition/API features until demand, deliverability, compliance, and operator workload are validated.
